capabilities: Highlight crbasic fenced code blocks in Edit and Live Preview modes via CodeMirror 6
Highlight CRBasic in Reading View using PrismJS-compatible classes
Color keywords, built-in functions, operators, constants, strings, comments, numbers, and preprocessor directives
disambiguation: Not a CRBasic editor; it highlights code blocks but adds no autocomplete, linting, formatting, or snippets.
extras: README explicitly lists limitations: no autocomplete, linting, formatting, snippets, or file type associations; tested only on Obsidian 1.12.7+.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in highlighting for CRBasic, so datalogger program code in notes renders as plain text.

relations.evidence: Token lists derived from the Campbell Scientific VSCode CRBasic extension

summary: Syntax highlighter that renders CRBasic (Campbell Scientific datalogger language) fenced code blocks in edit, preview, and reading modes.
